fieldNotes.alreadyInstalled: True means a local Ode package root with a matching MicrosoftGame.config StoreId was found; install completeness is separate.
fieldNotes.antiCheat: Copied from the evidence-backed compatibility catalogue; unknown is not a no-anti-cheat claim.
fieldNotes.api: Sourced testing API; apiBasis distinguishes requirements, engine/layout inference and renderer-library imports. Not an observed active renderer. DX9/DX10/OpenGL are preserved rather than relabeled DX11.
fieldNotes.downloadSizeBytes: Always numeric. Windows MSIXVC catalog maximum download bytes, not Steam disk requirement. 0 plus downloadSizeKnown=false means unknown.
fieldNotes.signInNeeded: True only with title-specific public/runtime evidence, false only with verified optional/offline behavior, null if unverified. RequiresXboxLive is console-only; Xbox identity presence does not imply mandatory sign-in.
fieldNotes.sizeBytes: Installed-root footprint, not download size. Always numeric; 0 plus sizeKnown=false means not measured.

rankingMethod: Already-installed retests first, retaining their prior relative order. Remaining titles rank released ahead of unreleased, exclude named anti-cheat, prefer known no-sign-in over unknown over required, then known catalog size, then descending log10(1 + Steam total reviews)/(1 + Windows MSIXVC catalog download GiB/10). Steam review count is an audience proxy, not player count or Xbox popularity. Unknown sign-in/anti-cheat is not a no-sign-in/no-cheat claim; preorders/stubs go last.
